_comment: Multi-lens deal scorecard. Each lens is 0-100 (a sum of named contributions clamped to cap); its CONFIDENCE reflects which INPUTS fired, never the score value. The overall tier is a best-available read of the three lenses, never a blend. Every weight is editable; scripts never hardcode them. Mirrors the explainable ethos of county-records scoring.

cashflow._comment: Reuses rental-cashflow's DSCR + monthly cash flow (self_managed). Anchor rent is the first available in anchorPriority - default underwrites to realistic market rent (user estimate, then Zillow), with Section 8 (hud_fmr) as the conservative fallback. Flip to ['hud_fmr', ...] for a voucher-focused screen.

margin._comment: Built-in equity from list price vs value. Value is ARV if supplied, else the Zillow Zestimate. Zestimate is suppressed on distressed listings - never treat a null value as $0; the lens returns NONE and asks for an ARV.

motivation._comment: Layered. Layer 1 (listing signals) is universal from Zillow. Layer 2 (distress) reuses the two-axis engine and fires only when a lis pendens + CAD data are supplied (a property that came from a county-records lead). Layer 2 replaces Layer 1 when present.

distress._comment: Copied from county-records/config/scoring.json motivation block so this skill stays self-contained (no cross-skill imports).

tiers._comment: A = two lenses strong. B = one lens strong (a single available lens caps here). C = all-middling. D = a DISQUALIFYING cashflow/margin failure with no strong lens to offset. A weak MOTIVATION never disqualifies - it only promotes. A missing lens is skipped, never scored 0, never buries the tier.
